text: In a typical E. coli σ70 promoter, what are the consensus sequences and spacing of its two core recognition elements?
choices: A -35 element (TTGACA) and a -10 Pribnow box (TATAAT), separated by a spacer of 17 ± 1 bp
A -10 element (TTGACA) and a -35 Pribnow box (TATAAT), separated by a spacer of 35 bp
A Shine-Dalgarno sequence (~AAGG) positioned 7-8 nucleotides upstream of the start codon
A TATA box positioned 25-30 bp upstream of the transcription start site, as in eukaryotic core promoters
explanation: The canonical σ70 promoter has a -35 element (consensus TTGACA) and a -10 Pribnow box (consensus TATAAT), separated by a spacer of 17 ± 1 bp, which is critical for promoter activity. Choice 1 swaps the element names/sequences and gives an incorrect spacer length. Choice 2 describes the ribosome binding site (a translation-level part, not a promoter), and choice 3 describes a eukaryotic RNA polymerase II core promoter element, not a bacterial σ70 promoter.
